idea: Factor 80325 as 3² · 5² · 357, so divisibility forces 17 to occur among the factors of n! once n is below 17? More directly, if n < 17 then n! has no prime factor 17, while 80325 contains 17; derive the contradiction by showing 17 divides n! from the given divisibility.
proof:
have h17 : 17 ∣ 80325 := by norm_num
  have hdiv : 17 ∣ n ! := dvd_trans h17 h₁
  by_contra h
  have hn : n < 17 := by omega
  have hfac : n ! < 17 := by
    interval_cases n <;> norm_num at *
  omega
